授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、留学や将来の学術研究のために、アカデミックなテーマについてディスカッションするための高度なコミュニケーション・スキルを身につけ、IELTSのような標準的なテストの受験スキルを向上させます。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course combines preparation for the IELTS exam with advanced academic English discussion. IELTS is the main English test required for entrance to international universities, especially in Europe, so students who are interested in studying abroad during university or for graduate school will benefit from this course. In addition to test preparation, we will practice advanced discussion and debate on real-world topics. Students will read or listen to English materials on topics such as current events, politics, economics, social interactions, technology, education, and so on, then discuss them in class. Students will learn strategies for politely and productively talking and disagreeing about difficult topics. This will benefit all students who want to be more comfortable having discussions on important topics in English.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: No specific prerequisites, but this is an Advanced level course.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Notes about generative AI (ChatGPT, etc.)::
Part of the purpose of this class is to prepare for a timed, written test (IELTS). Since it is not allowed to use AI on the IELTS, students may not use generative AI for any assignments that are directly related to IELTS preparation, which includes all of the homework that comes from the textbook. Students who use generative AI for these assignments will get zero points, and if this occurs repeatedly, such students may be reported to the university to face disciplinary procedures. For other assignments, the teacher will explain if and how AI can be used.
Regarding assignments:
Depending on the number of students and their level, the speaking project may be replaced with a different assignment. Changes to this or any other aspects of the class will be announced in class and on Moodle.
Regarding homework:
Since this is a 2-unit course, students will be assigned an average of four hours of homework per week.
